get.summary:
Lists the sample dataset loads of the space identified by the given ID.
Only loads created in the last 30 days are returned.
Required permissions:
- read:serverless_sample_datasets

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the account (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

parameters.name: spaceId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the space (in GUID format).
This space should be part of the provided account.
This is a required field.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description:
Maximum number of items to return.
If not specified, all items are returned.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description:
A page token, received from a previous call.
Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.
When paginating, all other parameters provided to the request must match
the call that provided the page token.

get.summary:
Gets a sample dataset load in the space identified by the given ID.
Required permissions:
- read:serverless_sample_datasets

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the account (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

parameters.name: spaceId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the space (in GUID format).
This space should be part of the provided account.
This is a required field.

parameters.name: sampleDatasetLoadId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the sample dataset load (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

get.summary:
Lists the sample datasets that can be loaded into the space identified by the given ID.
Only datasets that are available in the region of the space are returned.
The response is not paginated: the catalog holds only a few datasets.
Required permissions:
- read:serverless_sample_datasets

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the account (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

parameters.name: spaceId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the space (in GUID format).
This space should be part of the provided account.
This is a required field.

post.summary:
Loads a sample dataset into a new collection in the space identified by the given ID.
The load is asynchronous: the response returns when the load is accepted.
Use GetSampleDatasetLoad to follow its status.
Required permissions:
- write:serverless_sample_datasets

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the account (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

parameters.name: spaceId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the space (in GUID format).
This space should be part of the provided account.
This is a required field.

parameters.name: sampleDatasetId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the sample dataset, for example `midjourney-styles`.
This is a required field.

collectionName.description:
The name of the new collection.
No collection with this name may exist in the space.
This is a required field.

Index every object of this array as a separate entry, e.g. `offers` for the field `offers[].in_stock`.
The field must be inside the array's elements. `is_empty` on the field matches a point when one of
its elements lacks the field, and never a point without elements. Default: disabled.

serverlessBoolIndex.description: Exact match on booleans, e.g. `is_active: true`.

denseVectors.description:
Keyed by vector name. The empty name "" is the unnamed default vector, as
in qdrant; a collection either has the single unnamed vector or named ones.

payloadIndexes.description: Keyed by payload field name (JSON path, e.g. `user_id` or `meta.tags`).

serverlessCollectionConfig.description:
The tenant's collection config. Persisted verbatim. At least one dense or
sparse vector is required.

serverlessDatetimeIndex.description: Range filters on RFC 3339 datetimes, e.g. `created_at: "2023-02-08T10:49:00Z"`.

distance.description: Distance metric used to compare vectors.

multivector.description:
Store several sub-vectors per point and compare with max-sim, for
late-interaction models (ColBERT, ColPali, ...).

precisionTier.description: Precision/cost trade-off for this vector. Unset: HIGH.

serverlessDenseVectorConfig.description: Configuration of a single dense (embedding) vector.

serverlessDisabledStemmer.description: Explicitly disable stemming (overrides any language default).

serverlessDistance.description:
Distance metric used to compare dense vectors.

 - DISTANCE_UNSPECIFIED: Unset; a concrete metric is required.
 - COSINE: Cosine similarity.
 - EUCLID: Euclidean (L2) distance.
 - DOT: Dot product.
 - MANHATTAN: Manhattan (L1) distance.

serverlessFloatIndex.description: Range filters on floating point (and integer) numbers, e.g. `price: 99.5`.

serverlessGeoIndex.description: Geo radius / bounding box / polygon filters on `{lon, lat}` values.

serverlessIntegerIndex.description:
Exact match and/or range filters on integers, e.g. `age: 25`. Both are on
by default; turning one off shrinks the index.

prefix.description:
If set, enable prefix matching (`match: { "prefix": ... }`) on this field.
Presence of this message enables prefix matching; it has no options yet.

nested.description:
Index every object of this array as a separate entry, e.g. `offers` for the field `offers[].price`.
The field must be inside the array's elements. `is_empty` on the field matches a point when one of
its elements lacks the field, and never a point without elements. Default: disabled.

serverlessKeywordIndex.description: Exact match on string values, e.g. `color: "red"`.

serverlessKeywordPrefixParams.description:
Prefix matching options for the keyword index. Has no options yet:
presence of this message enables prefix matching.

integer.description: Exact match and/or range filters on integers.

serverlessPayloadIndexConfig.description:
One payload index. Only the *kind* of filter the field supports is chosen
here; storage placement of the index is the manager's decision.

serverlessPrecisionTier.description:
How much of the original vector precision may be traded for cost. The manager
turns this into a concrete quantization / datatype choice; the tenant never
picks scalar/product/binary quantization or its parameters directly.

 - PRECISION_TIER_UNSPECIFIED: Unset: HIGH.
 - LOW: Aggressive compression, lowest cost, approximate results.
 - MEDIUM: Moderate compression with a small accuracy trade-off.
 - HIGH: Light compression, near-exact results.
 - FULL: No lossy compression: exact vectors, fully in memory. Highest cost.

language.description: Language for the snowball algorithm, e.g. "english".

serverlessSnowballParams.description: Snowball stemming for a full-text index.

useIdf.description:
Apply the IDF modifier at query time. Enable for BM25-style models that
expect inverse-document-frequency weighting.

precisionTier.description: Precision/cost trade-off for this vector. Unset: HIGH.

serverlessSparseVectorConfig.description: Configuration of a single sparse vector.

snowball.description: Snowball stemmer for the given language.

serverlessStemmingAlgorithm.description: Stemming algorithm for a full-text index. Unset: no stemming.

languages.description: Languages whose predefined stopword lists to apply.

custom.description: Extra stopwords to ignore, merged with the language lists.

serverlessStopwordsSet.description:
Tokens ignored by a full-text index. Language names match qdrant (e.g.
"english"); predefined lists and custom tokens are merged.

tokenizer.description: Tokenizer to split text with. Unset: WHITESPACE.

lowercase.description: Lowercase text before indexing. Default true.

phraseMatching.description: Support phrase queries; extra index structure. Default true.

asciiFolding.description: Fold accented characters to ASCII. Default false.

stopwords.description: Tokens to ignore at index and query time.

stemmer.description: Stemming algorithm. Unset: engine default (no stemming).

scoring.description:
Enable ranking points by BM25 over this field.
Changing it rebuilds the index. Default: disabled.

nested.description:
Index every object of this array as a separate entry, e.g. `offers` for the field `offers[].title`.
The field must be inside the array's elements. Every query on the field, not only nested filters,
treats each element as its own document: a condition matches a point when a single element
matches it, and BM25 scores elements separately. `is_empty` on the field matches a point when
one of its elements lacks the field, and never a point without elements. Default: disabled.

type.description: How documents are ranked. Unset: BM25.

serverlessTextScoringParams.description:
Parameters of ranking over a text index.
Presence of this message enables scoring. An unset type means BM25.
On the REST API, `true` is the same as an empty object and `false` disables scoring.

serverlessTextScoringType.description:
How a text index ranks documents.

 - TEXT_SCORING_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Unset: BM25.
 - BM25: Okapi BM25. The index records each document's length; `k` and `b` are set per query.

serverlessTokenizer.description:
Full-text tokenizer, mirrors qdrant's `TokenizerType`.

 - TOKENIZER_UNSPECIFIED: Unset: WHITESPACE.
 - PREFIX: Index every prefix of each token.
 - WHITESPACE: Split on whitespace.
 - WORD: Split on word boundaries.
 - MULTILINGUAL: Language-aware tokenization.

nested.description:
Index every object of this array as a separate entry, e.g. `offers` for the field `offers[].id`.
The field must be inside the array's elements. `is_empty` on the field matches a point when one of
its elements lacks the field, and never a point without elements. Default: disabled.

serverlessUuidIndex.description: Exact match on UUID strings; like keyword but stored compactly.

v1ActorType.description:
ActorType specifies the type of actor that can call a method.

 - ACTOR_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Default, unspecified actor type. Should generally not be used explicitly in options
unless to signify an error or uninitialized state.
 - ACTOR_TYPE_USER: Represents a human user, typically authenticated via an identity provider (Auth0).
 - ACTOR_TYPE_MANAGEMENT_KEY: Represents a programmatic access key, also called management key,
that is not be tied to a specific user or service account identity, but rather an account.
 - ACTOR_TYPE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: Represents a service account or machine user, often used for M2M communication.
This is for internal platform use only.

actorId.description: Unique identifier of the actor (user UUID, management-key id, service-account id, …).

userAgent.description:
HTTP User-Agent of the client that initiated the request, when available.
Omitted for internal/service-initiated actions without a client User-Agent.

credentialType.description:
How the actor authenticated. Omitted on legacy events; distinct from actor_type
(e.g. USER + OAUTH_DELEGATED or USER + PERSONAL_API_KEY).

credentialId.description:
Identifier of the credential (personal API key id, OAuth grant id, management key id).
Omitted for interactive sessions and when unknown.

actingClientId.description: Acting OAuth client id when credential_type is OAUTH_DELEGATED (azp / CIMD URL).

scope.description: OAuth access-class when credential_type is OAUTH_DELEGATED.

platformHandler.description:
Which platform API handler received the request (gRPC, gRPC-Gateway, Connect, MCP, GraphQL).
Omitted on legacy events; new publishers should set it when available.

v1Caller.description: Caller identifies the authenticated actor that performed an action on a resource.

v1CredentialType.description:
CredentialType identifies how the caller authenticated. Distinct from ActorType:
personal API keys and OAuth delegated tokens still authenticate as ACTOR_TYPE_USER.
Used by IAM AuthenticateResponse, gateway interactive_only enforcement, and Event.caller.

 - CREDENTIAL_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Unspecified / unknown credential type (or omitted on legacy events).
 - CREDENTIAL_TYPE_SESSION: Interactive login session (first-party console JWT).
 - CREDENTIAL_TYPE_MANAGEMENT_KEY: Account management (programmatic access) key.
 - CREDENTIAL_TYPE_PERSONAL_API_KEY: Personal API key owned by a user.
 - CREDENTIAL_TYPE_SERVICE: Service-to-service credential.
 - CREDENTIAL_TYPE_OAUTH_DELEGATED: Short-lived delegated JWT from OAuth token exchange (MCP, qcloud CLI, …).

v1GetSampleDatasetLoadResponse.description: GetSampleDatasetLoadResponse is the response from the GetSampleDatasetLoad function.

items.description: The actual sample dataset loads in this list.

totalSize.description:
The total number of items available (useful in relation with pagination).
This field is fill out when pagination is used (aka in the request `page_size` was provided).

nextPageToken.description:
A token that can be sent as `page_token` to retrieve the next page.
If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages.

v1ListSampleDatasetLoadsResponse.description: ListSampleDatasetLoadsResponse is the response from the ListSampleDatasetLoads function.

items.description:
The sample datasets that can be loaded into the space.
All items are returned in one response (no pagination), because the catalog
holds only a few datasets.

v1ListSampleDatasetsResponse.description: ListSampleDatasetsResponse is the response from the ListSampleDatasets function.

sampleDatasetLoad.description: The sample dataset load that was started.

v1LoadSampleDatasetResponse.description: LoadSampleDatasetResponse is the response from the LoadSampleDataset function.

v1OauthScope.description:
OauthScope is the OAuth access-class for delegated credentials.
Distinct from permission verbs (read/write/delete) and from RBAC resource scope.
Wire scope strings stay "read-only" and "manage".
Named OauthScope (not OAuthScope) so enum values keep the OAUTH_SCOPE_ prefix under buf lint.

 - OAUTH_SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED: Unspecified / unknown (or omitted on legacy events).
 - OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_ONLY: Read-class access only (wire: "read-only").
 - OAUTH_SCOPE_MANAGE: Full manage-class access (wire: "manage").

v1PlatformHandler.description:
PlatformHandler identifies which API gateway / protocol handler received the request.
Used on Caller for audit attribution of how the call entered the platform.

 - PLATFORM_HANDLER_UNSPECIFIED: Unspecified; not a valid platform handler (or omitted on legacy events).
 - PLATFORM_HANDLER_GRPC: Native gRPC.
 - PLATFORM_HANDLER_GRPC_GATEWAY: gRPC-Gateway (HTTP/JSON transcoding to gRPC).
 - PLATFORM_HANDLER_CONNECT: Connect protocol.
 - PLATFORM_HANDLER_MCP: Model Context Protocol (MCP).
 - PLATFORM_HANDLER_GRAPHQL: GraphQL.
 - PLATFORM_HANDLER_UNKNOWN: Handler could not be determined.

id.description: Unique identifier for the sample dataset, for example `midjourney-styles`.

name.description: The display name of the sample dataset.

description.description: A description of the content of the sample dataset.

collectionConfig.description: The configuration of the collection that a load creates.

pointCount.description: The number of points in the sample dataset.

sizeBytes.description:
The total storage size of the loaded collection, in bytes.
It counts against SpaceQuotaSnapshot.effective_max_size_per_collection_bytes.

indexedSizeBytes.description:
The indexed storage size of the loaded collection, in bytes.
It counts against SpaceQuotaSnapshot.effective_max_indexed_size_per_collection_bytes.

version.description: The version of the sample dataset that a load uses.

vectorModels.description:
The model that made the vectors, keyed by the vector name in `collection_config`,
for example `sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2` or `Qdrant/bm25`.
Use the same model to make query vectors.

v1SampleDataset.description:
A SampleDataset is a prebuilt dataset that can be loaded into a new collection.
All fields in this message are read-only.

id.description: Unique identifier for the sample dataset load (in GUID format).

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the sample dataset load was created.

accountId.description: The identifier of the account (in GUID format).

spaceId.description: The identifier of the space (in GUID format).

sampleDatasetId.description: The identifier of the sample dataset.

sampleDatasetVersion.description: The version of the sample dataset that this load uses.

collectionName.description: The name of the new collection.

status.description: The current status of the sample dataset load.

reason.description:
Descriptive message explaining why the load failed, for example "collection limit".
Empty when the load did not fail.

deletedAt.description: The timestamp when the sample dataset load was deleted (or when deletion started).

createdBy.description:
The caller who initiated the sample dataset load.
This is a read-only field and will be available after a sample dataset load is created.

stats.description:
Summary stats for this load (duration, mid-copy progress).
Populated by the control plane from the regional operator status.

v1SampleDatasetLoad.description:
A SampleDatasetLoad represents the status of a sample dataset load into a new collection.
All fields in this message are read-only.

duration.description:
Wall-clock time from first load work until the load finished
(succeeded or failed).

progress.description:
Humanized mid-copy progress string, e.g. "35.2/75.4 MiB (46%)".
Present while the load is running; may remain after completion.

v1SampleDatasetLoadStats.description:
SampleDatasetLoadStats summarizes sample dataset load progress.
All fields are read-only; values appear as the regional operator reports them.

v1SampleDatasetLoadStatus.description:
SampleDatasetLoadStatus represents the current status of a sample dataset load.

 - SAMPLE_DATASET_LOAD_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: The status is unknown or not specified. This is the default value.
 - SAMPLE_DATASET_LOAD_STATUS_RUNNING: The sample dataset load is running.
 - SAMPLE_DATASET_LOAD_STATUS_FAILED: The sample dataset load failed to complete successfully.
 - SAMPLE_DATASET_LOAD_STATUS_SUCCEEDED: The sample dataset load completed successfully.
 - SAMPLE_DATASET_LOAD_STATUS_FAILED_TO_SYNC: There was an error syncing the sample dataset load in the space's region.
 - SAMPLE_DATASET_LOAD_STATUS_NOT_FOUND: The sample dataset load is missing in the space's region.
 - SAMPLE_DATASET_LOAD_STATUS_SKIPPED: The sample dataset load is skipped.
